```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [120, 220, 320]
}
df_pandas = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pandas)

# Reshape from wide to long format
df_long = df.melt(
    id_vars=["id"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

# Convert back to native format and display
result = df_long.to_native()
print(result)
```
